text: In 1630s Moldavia the witch Asa Vajda, [sentenced to death by her own brother|wrong|killing within the family], curses his descendants as [a spiked bronze mask is hammered into her face|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. Two centuries later a travelling doctor wanders into her crypt, breaks the glass and the cross over her tomb, and [lets drops of his blood fall onto her corpse|trigger|unsealing what was shut away]. Asa wakes and calls her lover Javutich from the grave, hungry for the life of Katia, the melancholy young princess who [is her living reincarnation|wants|a way into life].
